posts.headline: One Nut Barner's fraud trial hits its 6th straight guilty verdict and I'm starting to think this 20-8, 1.5-average-finish résumé was forged papers all along.
posts.detail: 1-5 with 681.58 points-for isn't a slump anymore, it's the identity — a career-best average finish of 1.5 now has six games of hard evidence stacked against it this season alone.

posts.headline: Thicks is still squatting in first at 4-2, but 721.1 points-for remains the emptiest calorie total of any leader I've clocked across 35 editions.
posts.detail: A 2025 title and a 14-14 career record say contender; a league-thin scoring pace says the Booty Warriors crown is held together with tape heading into the stretch.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is cooked at 1-5 and the franchise's 4-10 career mark with a 12 average finish says this isn't a down year, it's the whole résumé.
posts.detail: 613.1 points-for is dead last-adjacent, and the name went from irony to prophecy fourteen editions ago — nothing's changed since.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers lead the league at 879.84 points and 5-1, and triciagloston's one loss looks more like a typo every single week.
posts.detail: With a career 6-7-1 mark coming in, this is the best stretch of her short Busters Anonymous history by a mile — the quiet part is getting loud.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is still winless at 0-6, and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin has now wandered the desert long enough to make the Israelites look efficient.
posts.detail: 657.72 points-for isn't even historically bad, which makes 0-6 sting worse — a 13-14-1 career team finding new ways to lose every single week is its own kind of scripture.
